## Documinder · Daily Review
Checks every required credential for every driver, then classifies it with plain date math (no AI).

**Phase 1:** classification only. There is no email, no AI node, and no schedule, and the workflow is not published.

Fictional data only. Reference date comes from documinder_settings.test_reference_date (2026-10-15, America/Los_Angeles).

## 1 · Load
Settings, drivers, role requirements, every document version, and the expected test results come from n8n Data Tables. Each load runs once (executeOnce) so items never multiply.

## 2 · Classify
Picks the latest **verified** version of each document and validates the date. Endorsements with no date inherit the CDL date. Counts whole days left in the business timezone, then assigns state + current reminder stage (D90, D60, D30, D14, D7, D0, OVERDUE).

Also flags: missing · invalid_date · inactive_skipped · not_applicable.

Source: src/documinder-core.js

## 3 · Exit check
Compares every row with documinder_test_expectations (84 rows) and returns **PASS / FAIL** with per-fixture detail.
